subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue be tracked as part of the WhatsApp phone-code login PRs, or split into a separate WhatsApp 515 recovery requirement that must be proven before the phone-code work lands?
rationale: The report is not only missing phone-code login; it describes a manual gateway-restart recovery step, while the active PRs also introduce public CLI/plugin API and persisted-auth behavior changes.

options.title: Track In Phone-Code PRs
options.body: Require the chosen phone-code PR to preserve QR behavior, handle partial credentials, and provide live proof that the 515 `Logging in...` path no longer needs a gateway restart.

options.title: Split 515 Recovery Follow-Up
options.body: Let the phone-code feature land only if otherwise ready, but keep this issue or a narrower follow-up open for restart-free 515 finalization proof.

options.title: Defer Until Dependency Proof
options.body: Keep both phone-code and 515 recovery work paused until maintainers accept the Baileys pairing-code path and live proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Track In Phone-Code PRs
recommendation.body: Require the chosen phone-code PR to preserve QR behavior, handle partial credentials, and provide live proof that the 515 `Logging in...` path no longer needs a gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses public CLI, plugin SDK, docs, and WhatsApp auth-session boundaries, where the history points to steipete as the strongest routing owner.
